result.changelog: Fixed every error from the report. Aurora Unit 217, not 242, located Phaaze by triangulating Leviathan trajectories (overview, Phaaze, Olympus, Elysia). Norion generators now follow the Metroid Prime 3 and Generator C pages: Samus restored A and C, Rundas restored B, Ghor killed the Berserker Knight, Gandrayda cleared the Generator C room. Dark Samus personally led the Norion assault (Space Pirate Data). Meta Ridley was defeated in free fall and presumed destroyed, not driven off. Bryyo: Fuel Gel no longer carries the Bryyonians into space; the last Lord of Science found it after the war. Elysia: the 'five months' was the strike on a distant world; Elysia was hit a week after 217 went down. Theronian Bomb sequence corrected (Seeker Missile frees the second component; bomb fitted to the Spire Dock, which descends while Samus defends it, then she escapes by pod). Replaced 'chain reaction' with the planet becoming unstable and collapsing. Phaaze event order is now Homeworld Seed, then Valhalla codes, then the Leviathan opens the wormhole. Unverified items: Rundas destroying four ATCs is confirmed on the Metroid Prime 3 page and kept. Kept NZG41 and Proving Grounds on the strength of a WebSearch snippet; dropped the Norion-capture claim and the Craneyard route. Removed or softened: Jovian-steel door, Bryyo Ice warp terminal, Tallon IV references in the Elysian lore, 'fifth' Leviathan, 'Phazon thickened his armor', Gunship not recognizing Samus, Anti-Phazon purge. Softened: Metroid Prime husks are now 'resembling Metroid Prime', and the Valhalla ambush is now attributed to Federation intelligence. Added: other hunters woke weeks before Samus; Vanguard offensive and the Pirates' verdict on Norion; Mistress Gandrayda as a Pirate field commander and her own-form attacks; Rundas's Hypermode use; Ghor's ramming charge; Bryyus the First; Elysian Defense Drone; Elysians' fuel shortfall; Valhalla crew jettisoned (Pirate account); Samus killed the Infant Leviathan; Phazon build-up on Phaaze. Keys: dropped Colossus, Sammy, shapeshifter, Proving Grounds, Data Pods, Energy Cell(s), bare Theseus, Primals, armorsuit and Theronian. Added AU 217, Theonian Bomb, Elysian Seed, GFS/G.F.S. Theseus, Mistress Gandrayda, Generator A/B and Vanguard offensive. Left Steamlord, Infant Leviathan and permanent Hypermode keys to the bestiary-prime and phazon domains. The Olympus entry is now selective: bare Olympus/Valhalla need a context word (8 secondary keys). Retitled it 'Prime 3: GFS Olympus and the Valhalla' and cut its other-vessels paragraph. Trimmed the long entries to about 400 words or less; the overview is 514. Validated: 10 entries, no forbidden words, 1 game-title tag per entry.
result.unresolved: NZG41, the rescue from Pirate militia and the Proving Grounds rest only on a WebSearch snippet quoting Wikitroid; the breezewiki mirror was bot-blocked. Metroid Wiki's Rundas page still credits him with Generator C, against its Metroid Prime 3 and Generator C pages; the entries go with B. Rundas catching Samus on a slide of ice, and Samus firing the cannon after the blast, come from the draft and were not re-fetched. The Sylux ship appears only in the secret full-completion ending; the content states it as fact, and the condition is in the notes. Aurora Unit 217's length of service is left out because pages disagree (14 vs about 65 years). The Hyper Grapple/Phaz-Ing venting detail and 'only Phrygisian Samus has met' were not added because they could not be confirmed. Some Elysians and Bryyo wording sits at 399-401 words.
